valid.name: args integral floats exactly at cap (JS renders 1.0 as 1)
args 1e16 positional notation exactly at cap
args 1e21 1e-7 -0 and 2**53+1 use JS number rendering
args lone surrogate is escaped not an encode error
args lone surrogates exactly at cap (6 bytes each)

invalid.name: args integral floats one byte over cap
args 1e16 positional notation one byte over cap
args 1e16 over cap only via JS rendering (17 bytes each)
args big integer rendered through float64 (21 bytes each)
args lone surrogates over cap (6 bytes each)
args astral emoji over cap (4 bytes each)
